headlineExplain.summary: How to read the headline: 4,635 identical questions per model
headlineExplain.scoring: Answer accuracy counts selected answers that match the answer key. It ignores probability-format checks, which remain in the detailed results. This presents the existing shared-question comparison; it does not change saved scoring.
headlineExplain.exclusions: We exclude 1,000 questions with more options than some models accept, plus 36 inputs exceeding a tested context setting. The same exclusions apply to every model. These 4,635 questions are a restricted comparison, not all 7,671 cases.
headlineExplain.winnow: Winnow accepts up to 64 choices. Arena mistakenly sent 500 banking questions with 77 choices. Those requests are outside this shared score. They remain in the original attempt log, not treated as reasoning errors here. The old 84.87% is a different, all-attempt strict score.

overview.takeawaysNote: This findings page describes completed v2 (27 September) and ABCD (28 September), regardless of the saved run selected above. Results by question type uses the selected run.
overview.chartNote: Answer accuracy on shared questions. Typical time is the middle of three repeated timing-block medians; CLM supports only 172 of 200 timing inputs. Hosted timing includes network travel. One request at a time.

calibration.title: Does confidence match reality?
calibration.intro: When this model says “80% confident”, is it right about 80% of the time? Only valid answers with probabilities are included.
calibration.noProbabilities: This profile has no valid probability outputs for this chart. Empty bars are not evidence of 0% correctness.
calibration.axes: Across: stated confidence · height: actually correct
calibration.barCounts: Numbers above bars = answers in that group
calibration.footnote: Below the diagonal means too confident; above means too cautious. Empty groups mean no observations. These confidence estimates come from different methods and are not a universal ranking.

breakdown.title: Benchmark breakdown · correct + usable
breakdown.intro: Original strict scores, not the shared headline. Failed attempted requests count; unsupported inputs are excluded.

technical.title: Technical details · original scoring
technical.strictNote: Strict accuracy requires the reference label and Arena's output contract. The post-hoc label-only diagnostic ignores output-contract validity on the same reference cases. The overview presents the existing shared-question label comparison for clarity; original strict scores remain available here.

judge.title: Astra spot-check · separate from the score
judge.acceptedInSample: {{n}} judged correct or acceptable in the audit sample.
judge.explanation: Code compares all scored answers with the saved answer key. Astra reads a sample to flag ambiguity or questionable references. Its opinions do not change the accuracy above. Identical answers share one review; model names and answer keys are hidden.

scope.title: Scope of these results
scope.teacherAgreement: Public teacher agreement is distinct from verified correctness. No overall winner is declared from a partial cohort.

replay.emptyDetail: Finish an evaluation to replay actual decisions side by side, aligned at the first request.
replay.scopeNote: Quality requests only · load and warmup excluded
replay.sequentialNote: These models ran sequentially on one GPU. This replay aligns their measured request sequences; it does not imply simultaneous inference. No model ranking is inferred from animation alone.

operations.performanceIntro: Three serial blocks over the first 200 frozen JevBench public cases; loading and warmup excluded.
operations.serialProfileNote: Serial dispatch profile. Concurrency 4/16 and native batch acceleration are not measured.
operations.fullSuiteHint: Run the Full suite to collect three 200-request timing blocks, same-state fanout and three load/unload cycles.
operations.pairedIntro: Difference in strict correctness on each pair’s supported reference cases. Denominators can differ from the all-entrant shared label table. Descriptive 95% intervals; positive favors this entrant.
operations.pairedEmpty: Select another entrant in a completed run containing Jev or Qwen to inspect a paired comparison.
operations.ticketDecisions: Ticket decisions: {{correct}}/{{total}} correct. Unrestricted tickets sent to Review: {{review}}/{{unrestricted}}.
operations.noEpisodes: Demo and Full runs include recorded warehouse and ticket-routing episodes.
operations.ticketSuccessNote: Ticket success requires all 12 decisions correct. Repeated blocked moves count at each step; they are not independent failures.
operations.coverageNote: Coverage is retained valid reference answers divided by all {{n}} planned records; teacher records are in the denominator but are not eligible. These are descriptive test thresholds, not calibrated deployment settings.
operations.robustnessTitle: What happens when the input changes?
operations.robustnessIntro: Each changed input is compared with its original. Harmless edits should preserve the answer; changing a decisive fact should change it.
operations.cautionBody_one: {{n}} case in this frozen suite combines a payment or onboarding topic with the service marked unavailable. The reference routes by topic; Engineering is a plausible alternate reading. This was found after the Demo. Original scores stay unchanged; exclusions belong only in a separately labeled sensitivity analysis. Judge agreement does not settle that ambiguity.

replay.emptyDetail: Run Demo or Full to record warehouse navigation and ticket routing. Every seed stays available for replay.
replay.introTitle: Two workflow demos, many saved scenarios
replay.introBody: These tabs are task types: moving through a warehouse and routing support tickets. Full v2 recorded 20 scenarios per task, per model, both untimed and with a 500 ms deadline — 1,040 episodes in total. They are separate from the 7,671 static benchmark questions in Case explorer.
replay.introNote: Playback uses saved decisions. It does not rerun models, spend credits or change results. These simple environments show how decisions combine across steps; they do not prove deployment success.
replay.playbackInfo: Sequential inference · aligned at zero · {{speed}}× playback
replay.deadlineNote: In deadline mode, a late answer consumes a step and causes no action. The environment pauses for each decision in untimed mode. These are deterministic simulations, not external actions.
